_meta_note: Comparator regimes for second-pillar annuity payout, compiled 2026-09-25. Every value has a _source sibling. Shares are fractions. not found means searched for and not located in a primary source; no value is inferred from secondary sources. Full quotations and glosses: research/institutional/comparators.md. Archived documents: data/raw/compare_legal/<country>/ with rows in data/raw/SOURCES.csv.
hr_annuity_takeup_pct_source: Computed from Ministry of Labour working-group report 2024, citing REGOS as at 31.10.2024: 11,875 pension-choice statements, of which 7,687 (65%) chose a first-pillar-only pension and 4,188 (35%) chose a pension from both pillars; 4188/11875 = 0.3527. The report does not state whether the count is an annual flow or a cumulative stock, so use the ratio and not the level - confirmed
hr_beneficiaries_pillar2_n_source: HANFA godisnje izvjesce 2024, s. 2.3.4: beneficiaries of mandatory pension insurance rose 30.9% to 17.4 thousand at end-2024 (total MOD beneficiaries 21.5 thousand) - confirmed (reported to one decimal in thousands)
hr_choices_both_pillars_n_source: Ministry of Labour working-group report 2024 (REGOS, 31.10.2024) - confirmed
hr_choices_total_n_source: Ministry of Labour working-group report 2024 (REGOS, 31.10.2024) - confirmed
hr_commission_cap_source: not found: no sales-commission cap comparable to the Macedonian 2.5% of premium located in ZMOD. What exists is an acquisition-cost cap of 3.5% of the transfer inside the technical provision (cl. 77(3)(1)) and a prohibition on distributors giving advice or recommendations (cl. 120(4))
hr_documented_problem: falling share of new retirees choosing the two-pillar pension, which the 2024 reform answered by raising the first-pillar supplement from 20.25% to 27% rather than by touching the actuarial basis; MOD price-list changes reduced quoted pensions because of the mandatory CPI indexation obligation; no official annuitant mortality tables exist; the most popular product form (individual lifetime pension with guaranteed payout of the capital, about 50% of choices) is not expressly regulated in ZMOD
hr_documented_problem_source: Ministry of Labour working-group report 2024, sections on the role of pension insurance companies and on the 1.1.2024 legislative changes (data/raw/compare_legal/croatia/mrosp_analiza_mirovinski_sustav_2024.pdf) - confirmed
hr_guarantee_period_mandated_source: ZMOD cl. 113(1) offers guarantee-period forms as options, not as a compulsory feature; where chosen, the named beneficiary receives at least 50% (cl. 113(4)) - confirmed
hr_improvement_basis: qualitative correction of population tables for the expected lengthening of life over the payout period; no rate, no generational table, no ceiling prescribed; annuitant-experience tables do not exist in Croatia
hr_improvement_basis_source: HANFA consumer page (as above) + Ministarstvo rada, mirovinskoga sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike, 'Analiza i zakljucci Radne skupine za analizu stanja mirovinskog sustava' 2024: 'Jedan od problema istaknutih na radnoj skupini je nepostojanje sluzbenih rentnih tablica smrtnosti u Republici Hrvatskoj...' (data/raw/compare_legal/croatia/mrosp_analiza_mirovinski_sustav_2024.pdf) - confirmed
hr_improvement_ceiling_exists_source: No ceiling on the improvement allowance found in ZMOD or in HANFA Pravilnik NN 20/2024 - confirmed (absence in the two instruments that would contain it)
hr_indexation_mandated_source: ZMOD cl. 116(1)-(2): a CPI-indexed pension must be offered, adjusted at least twice a year on Croatian Bureau of Statistics data, and a non-indexed variant may be offered only alongside the indexed one - confirmed
hr_joint_life_mandated_source: ZMOD cl. 112(1) (obligatory menu), cl. 113(3) (surviving spouse receives at least 60%), cl. 114(4) (joint form compulsory where the spouse is over 50, unemployed and without other regular income, unless the spouse consents otherwise) - confirmed
hr_market_providers_n_source: HANFA register of mirovinska osiguravajuca drustva, accessed 2026-09-25 (Hrvatsko mirovinsko osiguravajuce drustvo d.d.; Raiffeisen mirovinsko osiguravajuce drustvo d.d.) (data/raw/compare_legal/croatia/hanfa_registar_mod.html); corroborated by HANFA annual report 2024 s. 2.3.4 and by the Ministry working-group report - confirmed
hr_max_interest_basis: no statutory cap; company's own rate set by reference to the expected long-term return on technical-provision assets, controlled ex ante via cl. 106 non-objection and the appointed actuary's opinion; acquisition costs in the technical provision capped at 3.5% of the transfer (cl. 77(3)(1)); surplus above 115% of obligations must be distributed down to 110%, one quarter to intervention reserves (cl. 88)
hr_max_interest_basis_source: ZMOD cl. 77(3)(1), cl. 88, cl. 106; HANFA consumer page for the rate-setting description - confirmed
hr_partial_lump_sum_max_pct_source: ZMOD cl. 112(8) (as amended NN 52/25): 'u visini od najvise 20 % od ukupno primljene doznake prije njezina umanjenja za naknadu Drustvu', conditional on the first-pillar basic pension exceeding the minimum pension (cl. 112(9)). Note: the HANFA consumer page still states 15%, the pre-2024 figure - confirmed (law text prevails)
hr_payout_regime_start_year_source: ZMOD adopted NN 22/2014 (data/raw/compare_legal/croatia/nn_22_2014_zmod.html); second pillar mandatory since 2002 per Ministry of Labour working-group report 2024, p. on second pillar - confirmed
hr_provider_type: dedicated pension insurance company (mirovinsko osiguravajuce drustvo), HANFA licence; life insurers may not pay second-pillar annuities
hr_provider_type_source: Zakon o mirovinskim osiguravajucim drustvima (ZMOD), cl. 1 and cl. 9, unofficial consolidated text NN 22/14, 29/18, 115/18, 156/23, 52/25, published by HANFA (data/raw/compare_legal/croatia/zmod_hanfa_consolidated.pdf) - confirmed
hr_table_prescribed_source: ZMOD cl. 16(2)(9) requires the licence application to contain 'racunske osnovice te nacela i formule za obracun mirovine, kao sto su tablice vjerojatnosti i kamatne stope s misljenjem ovlastenog aktuara'; cl. 106 requires unit pension amounts to be filed for a 30-day non-objection. HANFA Pravilnik o minimalnim standardima ... tehnickih pricuva, NN 20/2024, contains no mortality table (full-text search for 'smrtnos'/'mortalit' returns no hits) - confirmed
hr_table_projected_source: HANFA consumer page 'Isplata mirovine' (supervisor's own website, accessed 2026-09-25): 'MOD-ovi koriste populacijske tablice smrtnosti koje korigiraju s obzirom na ocekivani udio muskaraca i zena u populaciji te za ocekivano produljenja trajanja zivota tijekom razdoblja isplate mirovina.' (data/raw/compare_legal/croatia/hanfa_isplata_mirovine.html) - confirmed as supervisory description of practice, not as a quantified prescribed standard
hr_unisex_required_source: ZMOD cl. 105(1)-(2) (rodna jednakost, prohibits direct or indirect inequality based on gender difference in calculating the pension) and cl. 107 (unit amounts may differ only by type and form of pension, indexation method, age group and guarantee-period length) - confirmed. EU basis listed in ZMOD cl. 2: Directives 2006/54/EC and 2010/41/EU
lv_annuity_option_start_year_source: Ministru kabineta noteikumi Nr. 106 (11.3.2003) 'Muza pensijas apdrosinasanas tipveida noteikumi', in force 19.3.2003, repealed 29.4.2012 and replaced by MK 272. CORRECTION to the task premise: the Latvian annuity option does not date from 2020; the 2018-2021 amendments reorganised it and the requirement that the contract fix a monthly amount payable for the whole payout period (7. pants (1) 2)) took effect 1.1.2023 (transitional provision 30) - confirmed
lv_annuity_takeup_pct_source: not found from a primary source (VSAA statistics pages searched; no published series on policies purchased versus capital added to the first pillar located). Secondary commentary gives figures for policies in force and names two providers with a EUR 2,000 minimum; deliberately not recorded as a value and not usable in the paper
lv_commission_cap_source: not found: no commission or expense cap in Valsts fondeto pensiju likums or MK 272
lv_documented_problem: insurers set their own minimum premium, and members below it are routed back into the public pillar (MK 272 par. 67.4 and 68), so small balances are excluded from the annuity market by design
lv_guarantee_period_mandated_source: Not prescribed in the law or MK 272; the repealed MK 106/2003 allowed up to three payment phases with the first at least five years and at most half the premium paid out during it (par. 12), and expressly excluded any lump-sum death benefit (par. 4) and any surrender value (par. 10) - confirmed for the repealed instrument, absence confirmed for the current ones
lv_indexation_mandated_source: Not prescribed; since 1.1.2023 the contract must instead fix a monthly amount payable throughout the payout period (7. pants (1) 2)) - confirmed
lv_joint_life_mandated_source: Optional co-insured spouse under the repealed MK 106/2003 par. 6, taken into account in the amount; nothing mandatory in the current instruments - confirmed
lv_market_providers_n_source: not found from a primary source; the list of insurers offering the service is sent to each member individually by VSAA under MK 272 par. 67.2 and was not located as a published register
lv_max_interest_basis_source: not found: no maximum interest rate or prescribed discount basis in Valsts fondeto pensiju likums or MK 272
lv_min_premium_set_by_insurer_source: MK 272 par. 67.4: VSAA must inform the member of 'apdrosinasanas sabiedribu noteiktais minimalais uzkrataas fondetas pensijas kapitala apmers, kas dod tiesibas iegadaties muza pensijas polisi' (the minimum accumulated funded-pension capital set by the insurance companies that gives the right to buy a policy); par. 68: if the capital is below that minimum, it is transferred to the state pension special budget and the first-pillar pension is calculated or recalculated instead - confirmed
lv_provider_type: licensed life insurer; the State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA) is the contracting party and transfers the accumulated funded capital as a single premium
lv_provider_type_source: Valsts fondeto pensiju likums 7. pants (1) 2) and (1-1); Ministru kabineta noteikumi Nr. 272 (27.5.2003) par. 66-72; VSAA service description (data/raw/compare_legal/latvia/) - confirmed
lv_table_prescribed_source: Full-text search of Valsts fondeto pensiju likums and of MK 272 for 'mirstib' returns no hits; the repealed MK 106/2003 standard terms prescribed contract structure only (par. 5, 6, 10, 12) and no mortality basis. Pricing is left to the insurer under Solvency II and Latvijas Banka's general insurance supervision - confirmed (absence verified in both governing instruments)
lv_table_projected_source: No requirement of a projected or improvement-adjusted basis in the law or in MK 272 - confirmed (absence verified in both instruments)
lv_unisex_required_source: not found in the pension instruments: neither Valsts fondeto pensiju likums nor MK 272 contains a provision on sex-based or gender-neutral pricing. EU law (Directive 2004/113/EC as interpreted in C-236/09 Test-Achats) requires unisex pricing in Latvia, but the Latvian instrument implementing it was not opened, so Latvia must not be cited as an express unisex rule
n_comparators_capping_improvement_source: No ceiling on the mortality-improvement allowance was found in any of the four regimes. The Macedonian MAPAS bylaw ceiling of up to +3 years of e_x has no counterpart among the comparators - confirmed (absence verified in the governing instruments of all four)
n_comparators_prescribing_named_table_so: None of the four supervisors prescribes a named mortality table for second-pillar annuity pricing; Romania is the only one that even names a source (its national statistical office's population table) and it does so only in a definition - confirmed
n_comparators_requiring_projected_table_: Slovakia by statute (Act 43/2004 par. 46(3)) and Croatia as documented supervisory practice (HANFA consumer page, plus ex ante review under ZMOD cl. 16(2)(9) and cl. 106); Latvia and Romania require nothing. See research/institutional/comparators.md s. 6 - confirmed
ro_advance_lump_sum_max_pct_source: Promulgated law, Art. 55(1): the member may receive at most 30% of the personal asset transferred to the payout fund, once, as a single payment before monthly pensions begin - confirmed
ro_annuity_takeup_pct_source: Zero by construction: the law enters into force on 5.1.2027 (Art. 113), so no annuity can yet be in payment - confirmed
ro_commission_cap_source: Promulgated law, Art. 37(1): 'furnizorul percepe un comision lunar de administrare, din activul fondului de plata, care nu poate depai 0,05 % din acesta' - a monthly administration commission of at most 0.05% of the payout fund's assets, stored as a fraction (0.0005 per month, of the order of 0.6% per year). Increases need prior ASF approval, decreases prior notification (Art. 37(4)) - confirmed
ro_documented_problem: the payout design was constitutionally contested before entry into force: the Senate legislative record for L214/2025 lists two referrals to the Constitutional Court, a Constitutional Court decision, a re-examination in December 2025 and a second transmission for promulgation. The content of the decision was not read
ro_documented_problem_source: Senate legislative record for L214/2025 (document labels 'sesizarea Curtii Constitutionale', 'decizia Curtii Constitutionale', 'forma adoptata de Senat - in urma reexaminarii', 'forma trimisa la promulgare - dupa reexaminare'), https://www.senat.ro/Legis/Lista.aspx?cod=26986 - confirmed for the procedural history, not found for the content of the decision
ro_guarantee_period_mandated_source: not found: no mandated guarantee period comparable to the Slovak 84 months located in the promulgated law. A survivor component is defined (Art. 3(1)(40), 'pensie viagera cu componenta de supravietuitor'), and for programmed withdrawal the total paid to member and heirs must be at least the asset value net of legal commissions
ro_improvement_basis: none required by the law; only a static national population table is defined, and the actuarial basis is left to ASF secondary regulation
ro_improvement_basis_source: Promulgated law, Art. 3(1)(9) (annuity defined on survival probabilities, estimated future investment returns and the administration commission), Art. 3(1)(41), Art. 28(1) - confirmed
ro_indexation_mandated_source: not found as a rule: Art. 28(1)(e) assigns the actuarial function 'calculul procentului de indexare a pensiilor private viagere', but the law does not set the indexation basis; it is left to ASF regulation
ro_market_providers_n_source: not found: no provider authorised as of the access date could be verified. Secondary reporting indicates ASF issued Norma nr. 16/2026 on the authorisation of private pension providers (Monitorul Oficial Part I no. 712 of 27.8.2026) and a norm on providers' share capital; asfromania.ro could not be retrieved from this environment, so these are SECONDARY and must not be cited
ro_max_interest_basis_source: not found: no cap or prescribed discount basis; the annuity definition refers to 'rentabilitatilor investitionale viitoare estimate' without constraining them. Left to ASF regulation
ro_payout_law_exists_source: CORRECTION to the task premise: Romania enacted its private-pension payout law in January 2026, about eighteen years after second-pillar contributions started. Promulgated text archived as data/raw/compare_legal/romania/senat_25L214FP_forma_promulgata.pdf ('forma promulgata', file 25L214FP from the Senate legislative record for L214/2025) - confirmed for the content. The citation 'Legea nr. 2/2026, Monitorul Oficial Part I no. 2 of 5.1.2026' is SECONDARY: legislatie.just.ro and asfromania.ro could not be retrieved from this environment
ro_payout_law_in_force_date_source: Promulgated law, Art. 113: 'Prezenta lege intra in vigoare la un an de la data publicarii in Monitorul Oficial al Romaniei, Partea I.' confirmed for the one-year rule; the resulting date depends on the publication date of 5.1.2026, which is SECONDARY
ro_pillar2_start_year_source: Secondary source (widely reported start of second-pillar contributions under Law 411/2004); not re-verified from a primary source here
ro_programmed_withdrawal_min_years_sourc: Promulgated law, Art. 60(4)-(6): the monthly programmed-withdrawal payment equals the social indemnity for pensioners, annually updated; where the personal asset would imply a payout period longer than 8 years the monthly amount may exceed that limit provided the total duration is at least 8 years - confirmed
ro_provider_type: four categories, all requiring ASF authorisation as a provider: private pension fund administrators; life insurers (Law 237/2015 art. 20(3)(a)) without a pension-fund management authorisation; investment management companies (GEO 32/2012 art. 9) without such authorisation; and private pension payment companies constituted as joint-stock companies with an exclusive pension-fund object. Cross-border IORPs and PEPP providers may also pay
ro_table_prescribed_source: The law defines a biometric table but does not bind the annuity calculation to it in any operative article: a full-text search of the promulgated law finds 'tabel biometric' only in the definitions (Art. 3(1)(41)). The actuarial basis is delegated to ASF regulation (Art. 28(1)(i): 'alte atributii stabilite prin reglementarile A.S.F.') - confirmed
ro_table_projected_source: Promulgated law, Art. 3(1)(41): 'tabel biometric - instrument statistic publicat de Institutul National de Statistica i care furnizeaza informatii cu privire la probabilitatile de supravietuire i deces, in functie de varsta' (OCR, diacritics partly corrupted): a national population table published by the statistical office, with no annuitant adjustment and no requirement of projection or mortality improvement anywhere in the law - confirmed
ro_unisex_required_source: not found in the payout law: the words 'unisex' and 'sex' do not appear and there is no provision on gender-neutral pricing. EU law applies, but the payout law is silent
sk_annuities_in_payment_2025_n_source: Socialna poistovna release 22.1.2026 (7,333 in 2024, per the release of the previous year, data/raw/compare_legal/slovakia/socpoist_dozivotny_dochodok_2024.html) - confirmed
sk_annuity_is_default_source: Act 43/2004 par. 33(2) and par. 33a(2): a temporary annuity or programmed withdrawal may be agreed only if the saver's other lifetime pension income plus the pillar-2 lifetime annuity exceeds the referencna suma (the average post-2003 first-pillar old-age pension, par. 46da); par. 33(3) and 33a(3) provide the fallback where no insurer makes an offer - confirmed
sk_annuity_takeup_pct_source: Computed from Socialna poistovna release of 22.1.2026 for calendar 2025: 2,588 lifetime-annuity contracts concluded with life insurers; 7,800 savers used the whole saved amount for programmed withdrawal; 1,028 contracts under the small-saved-amount regime where no insurer made an offer. 2588/(2588+7800+1028) = 2588/11416 = 0.2267. On the applications denominator (14,559 applications in 2025) the ratio is 0.1778; applications and concluded contracts do not map one-to-one within a calendar year (data/raw/compare_legal/slovakia/socpoist_dozivotny_dochodok_2025.html) - confirmed
sk_avg_annuity_eur_month_2025_source: Socialna poistovna release 22.1.2026: average lifetime annuity from the second pillar paid by life insurers, without indexation and without survivor cover, EUR 26.20 per month in 2025 (EUR 24.55 in 2024) - confirmed
sk_commission_cap_source: Act 43/2004 par. 46f(16): 'V suvislosti s uzatvorenim zmluvy o poisteni dochodku sa nesmie vykonavat financne sprostredkovanie podla osobitneho predpisu.' - financial intermediation in connection with concluding the contract is prohibited outright; par. 46f(15) forbids bundling and par. 46f(10) forbids surrender charges. Stored as 0.0 meaning no commissionable distribution is permitted, not a numerical cap - confirmed
sk_documented_problem: 1,028 savers in 2025 received no lifetime-annuity offer from any insurer because their accumulated amount was too low and fell back to a statutory drawdown of at most EUR 14.90 per month until exhaustion; average annuity levels are very low (EUR 26.20 per month); the reference-amount gate makes annuitisation compulsory for savers with low other pension income and optional for others, tilting the pool, while the Act forbids any rating factor other than age and any pre-contract health question
sk_documented_problem_source: Socialna poistovna release 22.1.2026; Act 43/2004 par. 33(2), 33a(2), 46(3), 46e(8)-(9), 46f(13) - confirmed
sk_guarantee_period_mandated_source: Act 43/2004 par. 32(2): if the recipient dies before 84 monthly payments of the lifetime annuity have been made, the difference between the amount earmarked for those 84 payments and the sum paid is paid or transferred to the entitled person; par. 46f(3)(a)(2b) mirrors this. MPSVR SR: 'Kazdy z variantov dozivotneho dochodku A - D obsahuje 7 rocnu garanciu vyplaty.' - confirmed
sk_improvement_basis: statutory qualitative requirement that the mortality probability take account of future demographic development; no table, rate, generational structure or ceiling prescribed; the insurer's own credible data-based assumptions, supervised by NBS
sk_improvement_basis_source: Act 43/2004 par. 46(3); no implementing measure prescribing an improvement scale was located - confirmed for the statutory requirement, not found for any quantification
sk_improvement_ceiling_exists_source: No ceiling on the improvement allowance found in Act 43/2004 - confirmed (absence in the governing statute)
sk_indexation_mandated_source: Indexation is one of the six compulsory offer variants (par. 46(1)(a)), not a compulsory feature of the annuity itself - confirmed
sk_indexation_rate_statutory_pct_source: Act 43/2004 par. 42(1)-(2) and transitional par. 123ao(3): 'Percento zvysovania dozivotneho starobneho dochodku ... podla par. 42 je 2 %, ak Narodna banka Slovenska opatrenim podla par. 42 ods. 2 neustanovi inak.' Stored as a fraction (0.02 = 2% per year) - confirmed
sk_joint_life_mandated_source: Survivor cover is an offer variant, paid at the full amount of the annuity the deceased was receiving, for one or two years as chosen (par. 34(2), par. 36(1)); there is no perpetual joint-life form and no compulsory survivor component - confirmed
sk_market_providers_n_source: not found: the number of life insurers participating in the offer system was not located in a primary source (searched socpoist.sk and employment.gov.sk; offer lists are generated per saver and no published register of participating insurers was found)
sk_max_interest_basis: no statutory cap; the guaranteed return on technical-reserve assets used in the calculation must be registered in the offer system (par. 46e(2)(o), 46e(4)) and stated in the contract (par. 46f(11)); returns above it are surplus of which at least 90% must go to the insured (par. 42a(1))
sk_no_offer_small_amount_2025_n_source: Socialna poistovna release 22.1.2026: 'V rezime mala nasporena suma bolo v roku 2025 uzatvorenych 1 028 zmluv. Tymto sporitelom neponukla ziadna poistovna dozivotny dochodok z dovodu nizkej nasporenej sumy.' - confirmed
sk_payout_regime_start_year_source: Transitional provisions of Act 43/2004 effective 1.1.2015 (par. 123ao et seq.) introduced the current annuity/offer-system regime; Socialna poistovna reports annuity statistics from that regime - confirmed
sk_provider_type: life insurer (poistitel) under a pension insurance contract; quotes only through the statutory central offer system operated by Socialna poistovna; the pension management company may pay only a programmed withdrawal
sk_provider_type_source: Zakon c. 43/2004 Z. z. o starobnom dochodkovom sporeni, consolidated version in force from 1.1.2026 (slov-lex, the official state legal portal), par. 32, 33a, 46, 46e(1), 46f(5) (data/raw/compare_legal/slovakia/zakon_43_2004_slovlex_20260101.html and .pdf) - confirmed
sk_table_prescribed_source: Act 43/2004 par. 46(3): the insurer uses 'vlastne vierohodne predpoklady urcene na zaklade dostupnych udajov' (its own credible assumptions based on available data); no table is prescribed in the Act - confirmed
sk_table_projected_source: Act 43/2004 par. 46(3) and par. 46a(3), verbatim: '...pricom pouzita pravdepodobnost umrtnosti zohladnuje aj buduci demograficky vyvoj a jedinym individualnym rizikovym faktorom je vek budueho poberatela dochodku.' ('the mortality probability used shall also take into account future demographic development, and the only individual risk factor is the age of the future recipient'). Requirement is in primary legislation - confirmed
sk_unisex_required_source: Act 43/2004 par. 46(3): age is the only individual risk factor, which excludes sex along with every other factor; corroborated by MPSVR SR page 'Dozivotne dochodky': 'Pri urceni sumy vasho dochodku poistovna nemoze okrem vasho veku a nasporenej sumy ... zohladnit ziadne dalsie individualne faktory (ako napr. vas zdravotny stav).' Underwriting is further blocked by par. 46f(13) - confirmed
